about: Fitted BCPack tables (BC3, BC4, BC5, BC6H, BC7, plus the refitted BC1 slots); see formats/06a-bcpack-tables.md sections 6A.2 and 6A.4. Every value is fitted against neighbouring mips of retail textures, not extracted; null = no chunk reads the slot. Not game data.
slot_rule: A block i with back distance d > i reads preset slot (i - d) mod 256.

presets.layout: [[c0 R5, c0 G6, c0 B5, c1 R5, c1 G6, c1 B5], [alpha0, alpha1]] per slot

colour_codebook.layout: 256 symbols -> four 2-bit indices of a 2x2 quadrant

presets.layout: [[e0, e1] channel 0, [e0, e1] channel 1] per slot

endpoint_presets.layout: [w, x, y, z][R, G, B], 16-bit MSB-aligned stored fields

index_presets.exact: Pixels 0, 2, 8 and 15 are constrained by the anchor rule; 720 of the 992 slot/pixel entries that are read as anchors are pinned to one value.

headers.layout: [lane-15 E, lane-15 O, mode, rotation, index selection, partition]
headers.note: Modes 7, 6, 5, 4, 3 and 1 follow a formula on the rank of (E, O); the order of modes 0 and 2 is fitted.

index_presets.layout: [index set 0..1][16 indices in pixel order], 4-bit MSB-aligned

bc1.about: Slots of the BC1 preset window replaced over the third-party default (see formats/06a-bcpack-tables.md section 6A.2); fields are R5 G6 B5 of endpoint 0 then endpoint 1. All other slots are the third-party default.
